scope: training/calibration only; no independent held-out test
limitations: Synthetic right-edge placement is not a natural floater.
Binary low/high changes are not clinical Gleason Grade Group upgrades.
Controls overlap and reuse donor slides.
Repeated doses are not independent patients.
GP4-positive/noGP5 can include GP3; GP5-positive can include GP3/4.
Visual context diagnostic is annotation-informed, not a blinded detector.
